purpose: Blind independent H1 review of literature-to-data operationalizations without rewriting source evidence.

scope.allowed_inputs: The exported blind H1 worksheet, its cited frozen English formula evidence, frozen local input schema and snapshots, exact implementation files, and deterministic edge-case tests.
scope.forbidden_inputs: Primary-AI or H2 decisions, comparison columns, candidate dimensions, selected features, target counts, prediction outcomes, model performance, Qwen/Ollama, local model output, and external LLM APIs.

rules: Independently inspect every exported family and preserve every protected literature-evidence field byte-for-byte.
Treat source_reported_missing_rule as a source claim that may remain not reported; place project choices only in protocol_missing_rule and the four operational boundary fields.

Approve only when input columns, implementation path and hash, test artifact and hash, input snapshot and hash, missing behavior, denominator-zero behavior, empty-set behavior, coverage behavior, transform, and units are complete and mutually consistent.
Reject rather than infer when the local implementation does not match the H2-approved literature formula or when a test does not cover a stated boundary.
Use no outcome, label, downstream model result, or desired feature count.
